verdict.rationale: Hightouch runs on top of the customer's own warehouse and does not copy data into a separate system. Events, identity-resolution outputs and Golden Record tables are written to the customer's warehouse, where they can be queried directly, and a community report says no data is stored in Hightouch itself by default. Workspace resources (models, syncs, sources, destinations) can be pulled out via Git Sync and a REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, so leaving mainly means taking resource definitions with you. Missing for 10: explicit export/offboarding documentation, stated open formats for Git Sync output, evidence that audiences and journeys configuration can be exported, and independent hands-on reports of migrating off.
